title: Space bounds the work head radius
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-tape machine over the Boolean alphabet and let $c$ be a configuration on a Boolean input. Suppose every work-tape head starts at position $0$, and the total number of distinct work-tape cells visited through time $t$ is at most $B$. Then, for every work tape $i$, its head position at time $t$ lies in the interval $[-B,B]$.
hypotheses_covered: Total space used through time $t$ is at most $B$
